decision.label: no-promotion
decision.reason: r8/a2 failed its dummy reserve policy and was later shown instrument-incomplete; r9 failed dense-mrow startup; r10 failed custom-all-reduce initialization; r11 failed the frozen idle reserve. Independently reviewed r12 passed the bounded Stage 3 dummy-path integrity, resource, containment, and one-probe graph gate. This does not qualify the candidate; real Stage 4 main-weight evidence remains pending.

next_state: The independently reviewed r12 Stage 3 dummy-path pass satisfies the conditional entry dependency for the already reviewed bounded Stage 4 real-weight workflow. Stage 4 remains separately pending its managed acquisition, integrity, resource, health, and request gates; no result here authorizes routing, promotion, or qualification.
